body:
### Summary

When you have this particular setup:
1. Repo 1
1.1. Package _test_wheel_ builds "test-wheel"
1.2. Package _test_lib_ depends on `../test-wheel/dist/test-wheel.whl`
2. Repo 2
2.1. Package _downstream_ depends on _test_wheel_ via a git remote

When you run `uv sync` without a `uv.lock` being present (e.g. first run):
```
Resolved 3 packages in 398ms
  × Failed to download `test-wheel @
  │ git+https://github.com/jelmervdl/uv-resolve-bug-repro.git@630725fefbf418aa99354d7d5a06c49b37fa1ed4#path=/Users/jelmer.vanderlinde/Workspace/uv-resolve-local/test-wheel/dist/test_wheel-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl`
  ├─▶ Failed to read from the distribution cache
  ╰─▶ failed to query metadata of file
      `/Users/jelmer.vanderlinde/Workspace/uv-resolve-local/test-wheel/dist/test_wheel-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl`: No such file
      or directory (os error 2)

hint: `test-wheel` (v0.1.0) was included because `uv-resolve-local` (v0.1.0) depends on `test-lib` (v0.1.0) which depends on `test-wheel`
```

(Note that it tries to find the `test_wheel-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl` file inside Repo 2, not Repo 1?)

But `uv.lock` did get created. Running `uv sync` again:
```
Resolved 3 packages in 3ms
Checked 3 packages in 0.70ms
```

Similarly, I can now delete my `.venv` folder and refetch, as long as the `uv.lock` file is used for resolving dependencies, everything is fine.

Demo repo for _Repo 1_: https://github.com/jelmervdl/uv-resolve-bug-repro
Demo for _Repo 2_ can just be a pyproject.toml a la:

```toml
[project]
name = "downstream"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Add your description here"
requires-python = ">=3.13"
dependencies = [
"test-lib"
]

[build-system]
requires = ["uv_build>=0.12.5,<0.13.0"]
build-backend = "uv_build"

[tool.uv.sources]
test-lib = {
    git = "https://github.com/jelmervdl/uv-resolve-bug-repro.git",
    subdirectory = "test-lib",
}
```

uv versions tested:
- uv 0.12.0 (Homebrew, first noticed it, but updated to uv 0.12.0)
- uv 0.12.5 (Homebrew 2026-08-14 aarch64-apple-darwin)
- uv 0.12.5 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)
